subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Emerging Market Debt Bombs
description: One-minute skill: Emerging Market Debt Bombs.

hook.text: Sri Lanka defaults in 2022. The country runs out of fuel, medicine, and food. The president flees the country.

buildup.text: Emerging market debt crises occur when countries borrow beyond their ability to repay, often in foreign currencies.

discovery.text: China's Belt and Road Initiative lent $1 trillion to developing nations. Many now face unsustainable debt burdens.

twist.text: Debt trap diplomacy lets creditors seize strategic assets. Sri Lanka leased its Hambantota Port to China for 99 years.

climax.text: Emerging market debt isn't just a financial issue. It reshapes geopolitical power and national sovereignty.

punchline.text: Borrow too much. Default. Lose your port. Lose sovereignty.

quiz.question: What happened after Sri Lanka's 2022 debt default?
options: The country ran out of fuel and medicine; the president fled
